# fastly_account_product_ai_accelerator (Resource)

Enables AI Accelerator for the Fastly account. This is an account-level product: it applies to every service on the account, takes no `service_id`, and is not tied to a service version. Destroying this resource disables the product for the whole account.



## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether AI Accelerator is enabled for the account. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource (always `ai_accelerator`).
